meaning:
μισθαποδοσία, -ας, ἡ
(μισθός, ἀποδίδωμι; cl. μισθοδοσία),
pay­ment of wages, recompense; meton.,
(a) of reward: Heb.10:35 11:26;
(b) of punishment : Heb.2:2.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just penalty,
